notes.title: Progress Report (Sept 1 – Sept 5) & Delay of House Purchase Feature
notes.notes: [p]Dear Star Housekeepers,[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Over the past week, our updates have mainly focused on:[/p][list][*][p]Fixing certain quest flows that could get stuck[/p][/*][*][p]Correcting object sizes and properties that caused issues[/p][/*][*][p]Improving parts of the UI display and localization[/p][/*][*][p]Optimizing certain operations and prompts[/p][/*][*][p]Replaced problematic and questionable assets[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]However, we’re sorry to say that the workload has exceeded our expectations. The house purchase feature, which was originally scheduled to be completed this week, is not ready yet and will be delayed. We hope to bring it to you as soon as possible![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45106207/bbadcac5965a85d563ec1ae5c9a9f5069dd6a302.png"][/img][i](Work-in-progress UI preview)[/i][/p][p][/p][p align="start"]In the meantime, we’ve received over 70 replies in our feedback thread this past week—thank you so much! Your comments made us realize there’s still room to refine the details of the current version. Therefore, for this month, our updates will mainly focus on:[/p][list][*][p]Better quest guidance[/p][/*][*][p]Furniture search & categorization[/p][/*][*][p]Completing furniture sets[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]Thank you again for your patience and understanding. We’re excited to keep improving the game with your support![/p]

notes.title: Progress Report
notes.notes:
[p][b]Dear Star Housekeepers,[/b][/p][p]
Thank you very much for purchasing and experiencing [i]Whisper of the House[/i]! Your playtime, feedback, and encouragement have been truly valuable to our whole team.[/p][p] [/p][p]In the past two days, we have been working at full capacity to fix those critical issues, which led to less communication. At present, most severe bugs have gradually come under control, and we will communicate and share progress updates more frequently.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Recent Updates[/b][/p][p]Here is a summary of the main fixes and adjustments from the past two days:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed the bug where towels in the hospital could not be placed (after updating the game and re-entering the level it should be automatically fixed; if the issue still exists in version v1.0.0.4, you can try using Settings – Gameplay – Lost Items Rest).[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue where items could be lost when autosave was triggered while holding them.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a soft-lock in Ideal Home Showroom caused by wall decorations having no available placement space.[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed a crash issue when entering Lady Bai’s mansion.[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed a soft-lock where some items could not be picked up because they were covered by other furniture.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized several unclear UI elements and item errors.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new storage categories.[/p][/*][/list][table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][td][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45106207/343f737867d7e4ec21164b9f542dd2f89cfc708e.png"][/img][/p][/td][td][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45106207/baa8cb4e47c1d9d357dad245b6f810140f8c59a6.png"][/img][/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p][b]Updates in the Coming Week and Demo Voucher Compensation[/b][/p][p]In the coming week, we will bring the house purchase feature, allowing Ideal Home Showroom layouts to be purchased![/p][p][/p][p]At the same time, to compensate for the issue where Demo players did not receive the 2000 vouchers, we will grant 3000 vouchers to all players. We sincerely apologize for the loss caused by our lack of understanding of Steam’s library mechanism.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Other Upcoming Plans[/b][/p][p]Our focus will be on optimizing the current version’s experience, including controller & Steam Deck improvements, Mac trackpad adaptation, and other gameplay experience improvements.[/p][p][/p][p]Meanwhile, we will open a thread in the Discussions to collect ideas for what you would like to see in the game. Your suggestions will become an important source of inspiration for our future updates![/p][p] [/p][p]Once again, thank you for your support. Launch is not the end — the journey of Whisper Town has only just begun, and with your companionship and feedback, we will make it even better together.[/p][p] [/p][p]—GD Studio[/p]

notes.title: Hospital Towel Fix and Apology for Missing Voucher
notes.notes: [p]We would like to sincerely thank you for playing our game right after launch. [/p][p][/p][p]A patch has just been released to address the issue where hospital towels could not be properly stored. To ensure a smooth experience, please exit the game, apply the update, and then re-enter. We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused. [/p][p][/p][p]Regarding the matter of some players being unable to receive the 2000 vouchers after playing the demo, we are actively seeking a solution. However, due to Steam’s library system, it may not be possible to fulfill this exactly as originally planned. We will do our utmost to provide alternative compensation, and kindly ask for your understanding.[/p][p][/p][p]In the current version, the vouchers earned through gameplay progression should be sufficient to cover furniture collection, so you may continue to enjoy the game without concern. We will share further updates with you as soon as new progress is made. [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you once again for your patience, understanding, and continued support.[/p]

notes.title: Whisper of the House is Now Officially Released!!
notes.notes:
[p][b]Whisper of the House launched on Steam at 4:00 PM (CST), August 27, 2025.[/b][/p][p][b]
The game is priced at $14.99, with a 10% launch discount for the first week—get it now for just $13.49![/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45106207/057fe3d59ec781a1b34d8bb9ac0ddc452d954957.png"][/img][/p][p]The full release features 15+ main levels, 4 unlockable homes (earned through hidden tasks), and daily refreshed ideal home showrooms with random themes and layouts.  🏠 Have fun, and may you find warmth and little surprises in Whisper Town.[/p][p][/p][p]With love,
All of us at [b]GD Studio[/b] [/p]

notes.title: Official Price Announcement for Whisper of the House🧡
notes.notes:

(Standard price: $14.99. Enjoy a 10% launch discount during the first week.)[/p][p]$14.99 USD / €14.79 EUR / £12.79 GBP / ¥1,700 JPY / ₩16,500 KRW / HK$95 HKD

notes.title: Demo Update V0.8.1.20

Demo V0.8.1.20 Update Notes:

[*] Fixed the issue where the furniture store could not be opened.

[*] Fixed the issue where items appeared twice in Storage when placed back.

notes.title: Apology and Replacement of Inappropriate Content with a New Room
notes.notes:
Dear all,

We sincerely apologize for the inappropriate content and the absence of necessary content warnings. Upon reflection, we realize we failed to anticipate how distressing some elements could be, which was a significant oversight on our part.

The inappropriate content has already been removed and replaced with a new room in this update. 

It was never our intention to cause harm, and we deeply regret any distress this may have caused. We appreciate your valuable feedback and will continue to do our best to improve.

Thank you for your understanding.

Sincerely,
GD Studio

notes.title: Whipser of the House Demo Now Available
notes.notes:
Dear all,

The new Whisper of the House demo is now available for Next Fest, running until the 4th of March. Come join us for some cozy decorating fun!

The demo includes the first three levels, and you can share and explore customized rooms through the Steam Workshop.

Don’t forget to add Whisper of the House to your wishlist. The full game will be released later this year.

We’d love to hear your thoughts and feedback! Feel free to post in the community discussions or join us on [url=https://discord.gg/xb4eQQAC]Discord[/url].

Sincerely,
Goodman Goodhouse in Whisper Town

notes.title: "Whisper of the House" Playtest Open!
notes.notes:
[h1]"Whisper of the House" Playtest Open! [/h1]

Dear Players,
Thank you for your interest and support for "Whisper of the House"! 
After about a year and a half of dedicated development, we’re thrilled to finally share that the Whisper of the House Playtest is now officially open! If it’s your first time stepping into Whisper Town, welcome! And if you’ve played our demo before, there’s fresh content for you this time around. Here’s some info about this test version:

- You will move into Whisper Town and take on tasks from two neighbors, experiencing moving work in three houses, each with multiple rooms.
- Explore the town, enjoy the day-night cycle and weather changes, and use the new features of collecting items and drawing furniture to create your own home.
- You can now save your progress at any time in the game and return to past moments, which we believe will help you better complete tasks without regrets.

Playtest Details:
- "Require Access" Closing Time: Nov 24th, 24:00 PT
- Test supported languages: Chinese, English, Janpenese
- BUG Report & Suggestion: As this is still a development version, you might encounter some issues like glitches or inaccurate localization during gameplay. We really appreciate your patience and understanding. If you’d like to report bugs or share your feedback, please use this survey: https://forms.gle/uXHWUZ46hXnaWohQ9

[b]We’d also love to have you join our Discord to chat with fellow players and discuss the game: [/b]https://discord.gg/NXMG4wrdHU

GD Studio & Lightning Games
